title: LZHAMDecompressionAPISchema
description: Strongly typed JSON schema for LZHAM stream decompression API and bitstream status

bytes_consumed.description: Total compressed bytes consumed from input buffer

bytes_produced.description: Total uncompressed bytes produced to destination buffer

bit_count_remaining.description: Number of valid unconsumed bits remaining in 64-bit bit_buf

is_stream_end.description: Flag indicating if stream EOF marker was successfully reached

error_message.description: Diagnostic error message when status is non-zero
